summary: Per explicit human authorization grounded in Phase 146C's own NOT VERIFIED verdict, independently determined the root cause of the Blocking finding 146C found (CHGR-REQ-199 / CHGR-REQ-204 / human_governance_record.schema.json's required array cannot be jointly satisfied) and produced the minimum necessary amendment. Reconstructed governing intent from primary sources before selecting a repair: CHGR-001 Sec.11 (Authority Contract), Sec.12 (Assurance Contract), Sec.22 (Amendment Contract), CHGR-REQ-096/097/182; PEC-REQ-115 (Phase 144F, docs/contracts/PUBLICATION_EXECUTION_CONTRACT.md) -- the Coordinator MAY construct authority_basis_claimed only when a citation resolves, a conditional rule the Phase 143E schema's own unconditional required array was never reconciled against; IWPC-001 Sec.31 C-1's explicit Non-Blocking/Observation disclosure; and src/pcae/governance/publication/record.py's own _KNOWN_LIMITATIONS text (unmodified, read only). Five candidates evaluated against direct evidence: (A) CHGR-REQ-199 incorrect -- rejected, would violate CHGR-REQ-097/the Authority Contract; (B) the frozen schema's requiredness incorrect -- accepted, a sequencing artifact matching the schema's own existing optional-field convention (rationale/conditions/governing_references); (C) chapter sequencing incorrect, build the authority model first -- rejected as disproportionate to a minimum-necessary-amendment phase, and explicitly out of IWPC-001's own disclosed scope; (D) a canonical non-fabricated value already exists -- rejected as the direct repair (no existing sentinel-string convention; inventing one risks the exact fabrication CHGR-REQ-097 forbids), informative only as precedent for the nearest analogous pattern (governance_record_provenance.schema.json's repository_provenance.available:false wrapper); (E) none found beyond (B). Amendment: docs/contracts/CANONICAL_HUMAN_GOVERNANCE_RECORD_CONTRACT.md Sec.28 (v1.2) adds CHGR-REQ-207 (authority_basis_claimed removed from human_governance_record.schema.json's required array, becoming optional), CHGR-REQ-208 (the CHGR-REQ-204/205 fail-closed gate additionally enforces CHGR-REQ-199's existing limitations-array disclosure obligation), and CHGR-REQ-209 (no prior requirement narrowed/reworded); Sec.29 recommends 146E. src/pcae/schema_resources/chgr/records/human_governance_record.schema.json's required array (18 to 17 entries) and authority_basis_claimed's property description amended; src/pcae/schema_resources/chgr/manifest.json's corresponding entry updated (schema_version 1.0 to 1.1, file_digest recomputed to 1a59e2931c4e4b6c654f25823f0dc6d533e13bd015eb8bfe70e36bd878cdce58) and independently re-verified live via pcae.schema_runtime.manifest.load_and_verify_manifest (12 entries, shape-valid, digest-matched). One drafting error (an initial draft bumped the schema file's local contract_version const to CHGR-001/1.2; independently caught during this phase's own verification because contract_version is defined once in the shared envelope.schema.json chgr_envelope definition and composed via allOf into every records/*.schema.json file, making a conflicting local const unsatisfiable) was reverted before inclusion, disclosed at Sec.28.6.1/Sec.5 of the phase report rather than hidden. Publication Coordinator, Interactive Workflow, and runtime code are unmodified (Forbidden Files, No-Go Boundary). See docs/PHASE_146D_CHGR001_SEC26_AUTHORITY_BASIS_REQUIREDNESS_RESOLUTION.md. Verdict: AMENDMENT COMPLETE.
